task: TASK 6 - Existing Penpot -> Canonical IR extractor audit/acceptance

evidence: Extractor only bounds inline image bytes with maxTotalAssetBytes <= 6 MiB.
Integrated remote MCP transport has MAX_TASK_RESPONSE_SIZE_REMOTE_MCP = 15,000,000 serialized JSON characters.
sendTaskResponse applies that cap only when isIntegratedRemoteMcp is true.
Local/manual plugin mode has no equivalent total response cap, and ExportCanvaIrTool serializes full result.data to TextResponse.
blocker.impact: A large Penpot file with many pages/elements/text can produce an arbitrarily large local/manual export_canva_ir response even when image bytes are bounded.
blocker.recommendedCorrection: Add a mode-independent bounded IR response policy below the transport cap, fail closed with an explicit diagnostic/error, and cover it with a targeted test. Do not silently truncate IR.

notes: TEXT_RANGE_FILL_FALLBACK_TO_SHAPE is explicit warning/normalization and does not block strictReady; it is not silent, but remains a source-fidelity review item.
Multiple top-level Boards use deterministic root child order and emit BOARD_ORDER_FROM_ROOT_Z_ORDER normalization.

liveRuntime.reason: No listeners on Penpot MCP ports 4401/4402; audit did not start/restart Penpot runtime.
